_comment: Merge the hooks block into ~/.claude/settings.json, replacing /ABSOLUTE/PATH with wherever you cloned this. Both are optional; the git hooks are the layer that holds regardless of which agent you use.
_PreToolUse: blocks governance from reaching a source comment, before the edit lands
_PreToolUse_rulings: blocks or holds a tool call covered by an action ruling (never:/ask: lines); matcher is * so no tool can route around it
_PreToolUse_persistence: blocks unsolicited memory and conversational residue before it becomes durable project state
_PostToolUseFailure: after a failed commit, reinforces the scan-first and no-workaround protocol
_Stop: not installed by default: blocking Stop makes Claude generate another response; use install-claude --response-retries only if that tradeoff is wanted
_style: Use install-claude --concise --no-dashes to enable pre-prompt guidance and file punctuation checks. Both are off by default.
